当应用需要播放或录制音频时，请使用Audio Kit
根据开发语言选择合适的接口：ArkTS应用使用AudioRenderer播放和AudioCapturer录制；C/C++应用推荐使用OHAudio接口
当应用需要低时延音频播放（如游戏音效、K歌）时，请使用低时延播放接口
当应用需要实现音振协同效果（如输入法按键音振、来电铃音振动同步）时，请使用AudioHaptic接口
当应用需要管理音频播放的并发策略、音量、设备路由时，请使用Audio Kit的音频焦点、会话管理和设备管理能力
当应用需要查询和监听其他应用的录制状态，或需要处理多应用录音并发场景时，请使用对应的录音并发策略和监听能力
实现音乐播放器的播放、暂停、进度拖动和停止 / Implement music playback with play, pause, seek, and stop
添加麦克风录音并将音频保存为文件 / Add microphone recording and save audio to a file
实现实时采集音频数据做波形显示或音量计 / Capture live audio data for waveform display or a level meter
接入低时延音频流用于乐器、节拍器或实时监听 / Integrate low-latency audio streaming for instruments, metronomes, or live monitoring
管理耳机、扬声器和蓝牙设备之间的音频输出切换 / Manage audio output switching between headphones, speaker, and Bluetooth devices
监听插拔耳机和音频设备变化并自动切换播放路由 / Listen for headset or audio device changes and switch playback routes automatically
实现通话场景的录音、播放和回声控制 / Implement call audio with recording, playback, and echo control
设置媒体音量、静音状态和应用内独立音量控制 / Set media volume, mute state, and in-app volume controls
处理来电、通知和其他应用抢占时的音频焦点 / Handle audio focus when calls, notifications, or other apps interrupt playback
实现边播边录或双向语音的音频会话管理 / Manage audio sessions for simultaneous playback and recording or two-way voice
为游戏添加空间音频或3D声场效果 / Add spatial audio or 3D sound effects to a game
让音效和震动在点击或节奏点上同步触发 / Synchronize sound effects and vibration on taps or beat points
用 AudioRenderer 或 OHAudio 播放 PCM 流和自定义音频数据 / Play PCM streams and custom audio data with AudioRenderer or OHAudio
实现后台音频播放并正确响应系统音频策略 / Implement background audio playback and respond correctly to system audio policies
do_not_use_when: 需求是做图片解码、编码、编辑、EXIF元数据处理、HDR转换或AI超分辨率增强；应改用 image-kit / The requirement is for image decoding, encoding, editing, EXIF metadata processing, HDR conversion, or AI super-resolution enhancement; use image-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已集成可用的 HarmonyOS Audio Kit 能力与对应 API 版本 / The app has integrated the required HarmonyOS Audio Kit capability and matching API version
若涉及录音，module.json5 已声明麦克风权限且用户已授权 / If recording is involved, microphone permission is declared in module.json5 and granted by the user
待播放或录制所需的音频源、设备与系统音频服务在目标设备上可用 / The required audio source, devices, and system audio service are available on the target device
inputs: 音频源信息（文件路径、URI、流或缓冲区） / Audio source information (file path, URI, stream, or buffer)
音频参数配置（采样率、声道数、编码格式、StreamUsage 等） / Audio parameter configuration (sample rate, channel count, encoding format, StreamUsage, etc.)
播放或录制控制需求（开始、暂停、停止、低时延、耳返、设备路由） / Playback or recording control requirements (start, pause, stop, low latency, monitoring, device routing)
outputs: 音频播放器实例（AudioRenderer） / AudioRenderer playback instance
音频录制器实例（AudioCapturer） / AudioCapturer recording instance
原生音频渲染器句柄（OH_AudioRenderer） / Native audio renderer handle (OH_AudioRenderer)
原生音频采集器句柄（OH_AudioCapturer） / Native audio capturer handle (OH_AudioCapturer)
系统音效播放器实例（SoundPlayer） / System sound player instance (SoundPlayer)
音振协同播放器实例（AudioHapticPlayer） / Audio-haptic synchronized player instance (AudioHapticPlayer)
输出到扬声器、耳机或蓝牙设备的播放音频流 / Rendered playback audio stream to speaker, headset, or Bluetooth device
录制得到的PCM音频数据缓冲区 / Captured PCM audio data buffers
低时延播放或录制音频流 / Low-latency playback or recording audio stream
音频设备描述信息列表（AudioDeviceDescriptor） / Audio device descriptor list (AudioDeviceDescriptor)
音量级别、静音状态和音量组查询结果 / Volume level, mute state, and volume group query results
音频焦点或音频打断事件 / Audio focus or audio interruption events
音频会话对象或会话状态 / Audio session object or session state
其他应用录音状态信息 / Recording state information of other applications
空间音频能力和空间音频状态查询结果 / Spatial audio capability and spatial audio state query results

postconditions.statement: 代码中已创建并配置适合场景的音频播放、录制或管理对象 / The code creates and configures audio playback, recording, or management objects appropriate to the scenario
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set introduce Audio Kit APIs such as AudioRenderer, AudioCapturer, OHAudio, SoundPlayer, AudioHaptic, or audio manager/session/device-routing objects that match the requested audio scenario?

postconditions.statement: 涉及录音时，代码包含权限申请或授权检查流程 / When recording is involved, the code includes permission request or authorization checking flow
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task includes audio recording, do the edits add or update permission handling for microphone access, including request or grant checking logic?

postconditions.statement: 已实现至少一个明确的音频控制路径，如播放/录制启动停止、音量、焦点或设备路由处理 / At least one concrete audio control path is implemented, such as start-stop playback/recording, volume, focus, or device routing handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits implement actionable audio control logic rather than only declarations or comments, for example starting/stopping audio, handling volume/focus, or switching/listening to audio devices?
